recipes.name: Pancakes
recipes.instructions: Whisk all ingredients together into a smooth batter. Pour onto a hot greased skillet and cook until bubbles form, then flip and cook the other side.

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken Salad
recipes.instructions: Grill the chicken breast until cooked through, slice it, and toss with chopped vegetables. Drizzle with olive oil and season to taste.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
recipes.instructions: Cook spaghetti until al dente. Saute sliced garlic in olive oil until golden, add chili flakes, then toss with pasta and parsley.

recipes.name: Vegetable Stir Fry
recipes.instructions: Heat sesame oil in a wok, add garlic, then stir fry chopped vegetables on high heat for 5-6 minutes. Add soy sauce and toss to coat.

recipes.name: Overnight Oats
recipes.instructions: Combine oats, milk, chia seeds and honey in a jar. Refrigerate overnight. Top with sliced banana before eating.

recipes.name: Beef Tacos
recipes.instructions: Brown the ground beef with taco seasoning. Fill taco shells with beef, lettuce, tomato, and cheese.

recipes.name: Margherita Pizza
recipes.instructions: Spread tomato sauce over the dough, add mozzarella, and bake at 220C for 12-15 minutes. Top with fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
recipes.instructions: Layer yogurt, granola, and berries in a glass. Drizzle honey on top before serving.

recipes.name: Lentil Soup
recipes.instructions: Saute onion, carrots and garlic. Add lentils, broth, and cumin. Simmer for 25 minutes until lentils are soft, then blend partially if desired.
